properties.covered_states: Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Sikkim
properties.source: Geological Survey of India (GSI) National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM)
properties.description: Young, fragile folded sedimentary and metamorphic lithologies subject to high seismicity and intense monsoon cloudburst pore-pressure failures. Chamoli, Kedarnath valley, Shimla, Kullu, and NH-58/NH-5 corridors exhibit chronic debris flows.
properties.mitigation_notes: Site-specific slope stability geotechnical analysis required. Mandatory subsurface weep holes, reinforced gabion retaining walls, and prohibition of slope toe cutting without engineered revetment.

properties.covered_states: Kerala (Wayanad, Idukki), Maharashtra (Konkan Ghats), Karnataka (Kodagu), Tamil Nadu (Nilgiris)
properties.source: Geological Survey of India (GSI NLSM) & NDMA
properties.description: Steep western escarpment receiving torrential southwest monsoon precipitation exceeding 3,000mm/year. Heavy overburden laterite soil mantle susceptible to sudden translational slides and mudslides.
properties.mitigation_notes: Avoid construction in natural colluvial valley drainage hollows. Maintain natural vegetation cover; ensure unblocked surface contour drainage channels.

properties.covered_states: Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Manipur, Arunachal Pradesh
properties.description: High relief terrain subject to extreme precipitation (Cherrapunji/Mawsynram belt). Saturated clay-rich shales prone to rotational slides.
properties.mitigation_notes: Engineered terracing, horizontal slope drains, and bio-engineering vetiver grass stabilization.
